parts:
Hi guys,
I'm currently running the lecture for my stats class as interactive shiny documents. It's worked awesome so far but for some reason none of the apps are loading. Every time i republish, I get an error stating 'con' is not a connection. Any suggestions you may have would be super helpful. My students have a final in a few days and they're already starting to get angry...

thank you!
